KeyMood Fonts Keyboard (زخرفة الحروف) — trusted by over 2 million people — is back with a brand-new version: live animated keyboard themes, 500+ fancy font styles, and realistic key sounds.

Type directly in cool fonts inside any app: chats, social media, notes and bios. No copy-paste needed.

◆ LIVE ANIMATED THEMES
• 180+ keyboard themes, including 50+ with live animated backgrounds: rain on glass, falling hearts, starry skies, galaxies, moonlit forests and more.
• Fully designed keycaps on dozens of premium themes.
• Light and dark versions of every theme.
• Theme Studio: build your own theme from your photos. Pick key colors, shape, shadow, blur and font color.

◆ FANCY FONTS & TEXT ART
• 27 English font styles, 52 Arabic calligraphy (Zakhrafa) styles and 16 number styles.
• 440+ ready-made frames and decorations for your name.
• Live preview of every style as you type, then copy or share in one tap.
• Perfect for bios, captions, usernames and gamer tags.

◆ REALISTIC KEY SOUNDS
• 20+ sounds: clicky and thocky mechanical switches, vintage typewriter, bubbles, raindrops, glass, plus special sounds for selected themes.
• Haptic feedback on key press and release.

◆ TOOLS INSIDE YOUR KEYBOARD
• Calculator: do quick math in any chat and send the result.
• Quick Snippets: save replies, links and addresses, paste them in one tap.
• Full emoji, text faces (emoticons) and rare symbols.
• 13 languages, including English, Arabic and Kurdish (Sorani).

◆ PRIVACY FIRST
Everything runs on your device. We never collect or send anything you type.

◆ 30-SECOND SETUP
1. Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards.
2. Add New Keyboard > choose KeyMood.
3. Turn on "Allow Full Access" for sounds and photo themes.

Download KeyMood and make every message stand out!
